open_points.subject: Model M08 — Refusal / deliver action
open_points.text: A delivery is M08 for the refusals of A3 rule 4 and A6 rule 5, and M06 for the failures of A3 rule 5.
open_points.question: What concrete delivery conditions are A3 rule 4, A6 rule 5 and A3 rule 5, and therefore which delivery outcomes create M08 rather than M06?
options: The delivery operation returns M08 whenever the project or connection prevents delivery as a whole.
Every unsuccessful chosen photo returns M06 unless an explicitly enumerated condition returns M08.
Each referenced rule must be restated here as a concrete condition and assigned to M08 or M06.
open_points.default_guess: Treat request-wide project, connection and folder failures as M08 and failures attributable to the chosen photo as M06.

witness.initial: No connection exists for project id P, and the caller has a file name and source id it wants to deliver for P.
events: The owner starts a delivery through the calling flow.
The calling flow invokes the deliver-one-photo primitive for project P.
outcomes: The service refuses the operation as a whole and returns M08 with code unknown_project.
The service reports the chosen photo as failed and returns M06, because the absent A3/A6 rules do not identify unknown_project as one of the delivery refusals assigned to M08.
witness.observer: The calling flow, and consequently the owner receiving the per-photo result.

open_points.subject: RefusalCode unsafe_reference
open_points.question: Which product action and concrete unsafe-reference condition create this code, and is that condition an operation-wide M08 refusal or an individual-photo M06 failure?
options: Scanning a photo folder linked outside its root refuses the whole scan with M08 unsafe_reference.
The scan succeeds but reports each affected photo as M06 unsafe_reference.
Delivery of a selected source that resolves outside the confirmed root returns M08 unsafe_reference.
Delivery of that selected source returns M06 unsafe_reference.
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the whole operation with M08 unsafe_reference whenever using the confirmed connection would require resolving any folder or selected source outside its root.

witness.initial: Project P has a confirmed connection whose photo subfolder was inside its root when confirmed; afterward that subfolder is replaced by a link to a directory outside the root.
events: The owner starts a delivery run for P.
The calling flow invokes the scan primitive, causing the linked photo folder to be used.
outcomes: The scan is refused as a whole and returns M08 unsafe_reference.
The scan returns a normal per-file result in which a discovered or selected photo is rejected as M06 unsafe_reference.
witness.observer: The calling flow and the owner, who respectively receive either an operation refusal or a photo-level failure.
